data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Manage the environment signing key: generate it and rotate it in three steps without clients rejecting new content.

data.name: AccessDeniedMessage
data.value: Only a system administrator can manage the signing key.

data.name: NoKeyConfigured
data.value: No environment signing key exists yet. Indexes are published unsigned until one is generated.

data.name: GenerateDescription
data.value: Generate the first key. Afterwards copy its public key into the registry values shown on this page.

data.name: NextKey
data.value: Next key (prepared, not used for signing yet)

data.name: PreviousKey
data.value: Previous key (public part only, still trusted by clients)

data.name: CopyFailed
data.value: Copy failed — please copy the text manually.

data.name: StepCurrentOnly
data.value: Clients trust the current key only. To rotate, prepare a next key.

data.name: StepNextPrepared
data.value: A next key is prepared. Deploy these values so clients trust both keys, then activate the next key. Signing still uses the current key.

data.name: StepPreviousKept
data.value: The next key is active and the old key is kept as previous. These values are already deployed. After every team has been regenerated and picked up, retire the previous key and remove PublicKeyPrevious.

data.name: PrepareConfirm
data.value: Create a next key. Signing continues with the current key until you activate the next one.

data.name: ActivateConfirm
data.value: Only activate after every machine has received the registry values above. Then run Index Management → Regenerate all teams.

data.name: DiscardConfirm
data.value: Discard the prepared next key. Its private key is deleted and cannot be recovered.

data.name: RetireConfirm
data.value: Only retire after all teams have been regenerated with the current key and every machine has picked them up.

data.name: GeneratedOk
data.value: Key generated. Deploy its public key to the registry values below, then regenerate all teams.

data.name: PreparedOk
data.value: Next key prepared. Deploy the registry values below; signing still uses the current key.

data.name: ActivatedOk
data.value: Next key activated. Now regenerate all team indexes so they are signed with it.

data.name: RetiredOk
data.value: Previous key retired. Remove PublicKeyPrevious from the registry values.

data.name: UnreadableMessage
data.value: The environment signing key exists or may exist, but could not be read: {0}. Publishing is blocked until access is restored. No action is offered, because replacing an unreadable key would leave every device that trusts it unable to verify content.
